scotch-233-performance-green-masking-tap.title: SCOTCH® 233+ PERFORMANCE GREEN MASKING TAPE – Tape, 1” / 24MM / 24/CS
scotch-233-performance-green-masking-tap.description: Highly conformable, provides the best adhesive transfer resistance, hugs curves, contours and provides outstanding paint lines. Goes on quickly and easily, sticks at a touch and stays put. Perfectly balanced to give outstanding results. This unique, green colored tape has excellent conformability, transfer resistance, and is resistant to bleed through. 233+ is more UV resistant than traditional masking tapes. Adhesion to steel: 38oz. /in width. Tensile: 25lbs/in. Tape thickness: 6.7 mils. Temp range: 250° F (121° C) for 30 minutes.
